dict.Garanția materială a fiecărui gestionar:: Each stock keeper's material guarantee: the amount set at appointment, the initial deposit and the monthly salary deduction; you get the amount built up so far, what is left to build up, in how many months and the status: complete (green), in progress (yellow) or not started (red), with the totals on the right.
dict.Garanția stabilită e cea din decizia de: The guarantee set is the one in the appointment decision (Docs → Storekeeper appointment decision).
dict.La „Luni reținute” scrii câte rețineri s: Under “Months deducted” enter how many salary deductions have been made; the amount built up and the months left are calculated automatically.
dict.Suma, reținerile și contul se stabilesc: The amount, the deductions and the account are set by law and the guarantee contract: check them with the accountant.
